title: There's a serial killer in my Mall World
content: He lives in an abandoned apartment building, and he can only "get" you if you spend enough time in the lobby of the apartment building. The way he kills you is, he knocks you out, and then seals you up in one of the apartments. He forces you to act out a normal life until you slowly waste away. He has been trying to lure me into his lobby for quite some time, but I always escape at the last minute. At that point, I either wake up, or venture deeper into Mall World. Has anyone else experienced anything like this? The apartment building is a tall, white tower in the middle of town, surrounded by a bunch of little shops.
